title: manifest.jsonl — NADA study document
description: One document attached to a NADA study: a questionnaire, report, technical document, or whatever else the instance groups under a <legend>. `resource_type` is deliberately an open string and NOT an enum — the legend vocabulary varies per study (study 1 shows Questionnaires/Reports/Technical documents, study 150 shows Reports/Technical documents/Other Materials), and an enum would reject an unseen legend on a corpus that already validates. `fetched_at` is set ONLY when bytes were retrieved; on a `skipped_exists` or `listed` row it is null and `checked_at` carries the time we looked. `content_type` is recorded as served even though it is wrong — NADA sends application/octet-stream for PDFs, which is why the filename comes from data-filename / Content-Disposition instead.
